Class Recipe

java.lang.Object
potionprodigy.Recipe

    • matches

      public boolean matches(Ingredient base, ArrayList<Ingredient> fruits)
      Checks whether the supplied base and fruits match this recipe. Fruit order must not affect the result.
      Parameters:
      base - selected base
      fruits - selected fruits
      Returns:
      true when the ingredients match this recipe
